title: Propose K annealing and per-episode sampled control rates
doing: Keep two separately gated untried options after the fixed-K matrix: globally anneal4/3/2/1 on a registered raw-frame clock, or sample K from1/2/3/4 at episode start and hold it for that episode. Specify K observability, per-transition discounts, rollout accounting and live-state continuity before implementation or launch.
expected: Gradual rate changes may ease warm-start adaptation, while sampled K may produce a more flexible policy. Either can instead impair learning through changing transition times, hidden K or mixed credit horizons; these mechanisms are untested.

evidence.label: User-directed second steer: control-rate hyperparameter and LR schedules
